svg.aria-label: User flow for giving access in four steps. Entry from the permissions list, a person or team page, or a data plane (planned). 01 Members: TIBCO SSO, LDAP, SAML IdP, a team or an IdP group. 02 Role: Owner, Data Plane Manager, Capability Manager or Viewer. 03 Scope: Owner gets all resources, selected and locked; other roles pick specific places across DataPlane Management, Kubernetes capabilities and on prem products. Leaving early asks before discarding.
